recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Do not use FHIR-36301 to remove current Device normative markers; any concern about Device's R6 normative readiness should be handled as a new human/work-group review item against the R6 normative-ballot decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-36301 was a Published/Persuasive R5 OO change request asking that normative markers in the Device resource definition be removed while Device was not proceeding as normative for R5.
initial_application: The Jira comment linked PR commit 959edb68. Current git history shows the substantive Device application in adjacent pre-merge commit 746a6a0e8c, which changed selected source/device/bundle-Device-search-params.xml entries from normative to trial-use; the FHIR-keyed follow-up commit 4fddf63f45 only added trailing whitespace to the same file.
additional_context: OO minutes from March and June 2022 confirm the R5 plan to remove Device normative markers and defer Device normative consideration until R6. Later R6 work changed the premise: FHIR-53389 is Applied/Persuasive and requires Device search parameters to be normative, d022c23cff applied that to the search-parameter bundle, 5c20769cc7 changed the Device StructureDefinition standards-status to normative, and FHIR-53625 added the current ballot note that Device is being prepared for Normative status. source/fhir.ini lists Device as active and approved.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Removing current Device normative markers would revert later R6 normative-ballot work rather than complete FHIR-36301.
